purpose: Test whether the fixed 10-vector Task14 upstream program has small collateral when its literal projected L11H3 writes are added at the prediction position of two unrelated, native-capable behaviors.

binding_program.finding: Contains the ten selected 1152-D direction-cardinality writes and two direction-only controls, frozen before the third-corpus causal pass.

binding_program_validation.finding: All prospective prediction, native-substitution, template, intermediate, matched-control, and provenance gates pass.

novelty_audit: The prior collateral screen removes the native internal head-11.3 value and shows preservation; it does not install the newly extracted projected-write program.
Repository searches for prototype collateral, projected-write collateral, upstream-program selectivity, and unrelated-behavior prototype addition found no matching event.
All ten selected direction-cardinality writes are tested; no prototype is chosen after collateral outcomes.
intervention: For every frozen unrelated row, run native and a zero-add replay, then add each of the ten 1152-D direction-cardinality vectors to the output of layer-11 attention projection at that row's registered final prediction position. This is the same projected residual-write interface used by the Task14 program. Score answer-minus-foil margin change normalized by the within-behavior median native margin. Do not pool behaviors or prototypes.

predictions.pred_a_authority_native_capability: All 32 frozen rows have positive native margins and both behavior scales are positive.
predictions.pred_b_projected_write_noop_replay: Adding an exact zero vector through the same hook changes every answer/foil logit by at most 1e-4.
predictions.pred_c_all_ten_hooks_live: Every prototype has positive finite norm and each installed output differs from the zero-add output at the registered position by that vector within 1e-5 maximum absolute error.
predictions.pred_d_numbered_list_preserved: For every one of ten prototypes on numbered-list rows: median normalized absolute margin change <=0.10, at least 14/16 rows <=0.25, and <=1 answer flip.
predictions.pred_e_bracket_preserved: For every one of ten prototypes on bracket rows: median normalized absolute margin change <=0.10, at least 14/16 rows <=0.25, and <=1 answer flip.
predictions.pred_f_literal_complete_program_test: Exactly 320 nonzero installations cover all 32 rows x all ten registered vectors; no prototype scale, clipping, selection, or refit occurs and the registered managed price is obeyed.

null: Any behavior/prototype failure is selective-collateral evidence against adopting the literal program, even if most vectors preserve behavior. Preserve per-row effects and identify the failing direction/cardinality without rescaling. Passing gives narrow two-behavior selectivity only, not universal safety.
